mainEntity.name: What factors determine the best location for an outdoor sink?

acceptedAnswer.text: The ideal location for an outdoor sink depends on several factors, including proximity to existing plumbing lines, drainage, and intended use. Placing it near a water source minimizes plumbing work, while good drainage prevents standing water. Consider accessibility to your outdoor cooking or entertaining area, as well as protection from direct sunlight or harsh weather to prolong the sink's life and improve user comfort. Our team can assess your specific yard layout in areas like Alameda or Berkeley to recommend optimal placement.
